title: Security Entity
description: Defines security posture and baseline configuration. Parent for Certificate, File, Network, AppArmor, and SELinux sub-types. Used by enjoin and judge.

enforcement_mode.description: Overall security enforcement mode. strict = block violations, permissive = log only, audit = report.

compliance_profile.description: Compliance standard to follow (e.g., cis-benchmark, pci-dss, hipaa, stig).
